submit_summary: The `pop` method in `boltons.dictutils` was incorrectly calling `dict.pop(key, self)` which led to a `TypeError` when passing an integer as the key. The fix involved changing the method to call `dict.pop(self, key)` which correctly passes the dictionary and key arguments in the right order, resolving the type error and allowing the test to pass.
patch:
diff --git a/boltons/dictutils.py b/boltons/dictutils.py
index 7871672..f0c71ef 100644
--- a/boltons/dictutils.py
+++ b/boltons/dictutils.py
@@ -867,7 +867,7 @@ class OneToOne(dict):
     def pop(self, key, default=_MISSING):
         if key in self:
             dict.__delitem__(self.inv, self[key])
-            return dict.pop(key, self)
+            return dict.pop(self, key)
         if default is not _MISSING:
             return default
         raise KeyError()
